method: Parse every current frontend/src CSS file with PostCSS and TypeScript source with TypeScript AST. Inventory source declarations/occurrences; preserve exact values/scopes. No code is removed or rewritten.
coverage_claim: Static source inventory only. Counts are not defects, rendered usage, contrast, reachability or runtime passes. Functional color entries identify the function start; full declaration value is retained. String fragments may include inert/example markup. Source-less styles from dependencies, external CSS, public bootstrap and index.html require separate inventory.
